overview_description.description:
Halliday is a workflow protocol designed to automate workflows and manage reliability across various systems, including business logic and cross-chain execution. The company focuses on enhancing player onboarding and engagement in Web3 games and virtual environments, supported by notable investors like a16z and #Hashed. 

The company is an a16z and #Hashed backed growth technology company powering player onboarding and engagement for Web3 games and virtual worlds.

competitors_list.target_short_description: Analog is a decentralized, PoT based layer-0 network that aims to provide a secure and scalable way to transmit validated event data.
Router Protocol is a blockchain infrastructure project that allows interoperability between two independent blockchains.
Socket, which acts as a meta-layer that connects all chains, enables unified, multichain applications with shared liquidity.
Axelar is a decentralized communication tool that connects blockchain ecosystems, applications, and assets.
Chainlink is a web3 services platform that connects people, businesses, and data to the blockchain.
deBridge provides non-custodial cross-chain trading, gasless swaps, and execution infrastructure for DeFi applications and users.
Wormhole is a generic cross-chain messaging protocol platform that can use data, assets, and messages from other chains.
LayerZero Labs is a blockchain messaging protocol developer that allows decentralized applications build across multiple blockchains.
The execution and liquidity layer for on-chain finance. For apps, institutions, and agents. One API across every chain and vertical.
ODOS is a patented automated market maker path-finding algorithm that aggregates decentralized exchanges.
